name: Scooby-Doo and Scrappy-Doo
description: Everyone’s favorite mystery-solving Great Dane is here to find clues, along with a little help from his energetic nephew and four human companions.

videos.title: The Scarab Lives!
videos.overview: The Scooby-Doo gang's most favourite comic-book super hero, The Scarab, comes to real life as a super villain!!! Trying to prove their hero's innocence, the gang convice the Scarab's creator to not give up drawing.

videos.title: The Night Ghoul of Wonderworld
videos.overview: The gang buys Velma her fantasy, which is to be ""Watson for a day"" to a robotic Sherlock Holmes in a futuristic Londonworld at the Wonderworld amusement park. Although it's all supposed to be a game, there really is a crime to be solved.

videos.title: Strange Encounters of a Scooby Kind
videos.overview: An alien ship kidnaps Scooby, Scrappy and Shaggy who are camping out at a construction site. It's up to Fred, Daphne, and Velma to save the three from the space ship.

videos.title: The Neon Phantom of the Roller Disco!
videos.overview: Sparklers Roller Disco becomes deserted due to the Neon Phantom. Trying to help the owners from an impending bankruptcy, the gang try to solve the mystery of who is the Neon Phantom.

videos.title: Shiver and Shake, That Demon's a Snake
videos.overview: A Snake Demon crashes the gang's summer time fun in Haiti.

videos.title: The Scary Sky Skeleton
videos.overview: The gang go to an air show where a Sky Skeleton ruins the aerial entertainment.

videos.title: The Demon of the Dugout
videos.overview: The Scooby-Doo gang investigate the appearance of the Dragon Beast at a baseball game.

videos.title: The Hairy Scare of the Devil Bear
videos.overview: The gang visit the Grand Canyon and stumble upon the Devil Bear, which is an old Indian legend.

videos.title: Twenty Thousand Screams Under the Sea
videos.overview: In Acapulco, the Sea Beast of the Aztecs rises and scares away all the divers. Of course the gang have to investigate.

videos.title: I Left My Neck in San Francisco
videos.overview: A Lady Vampire haunts the gang in San Francisco.

videos.title: When you Wish Upon a Star Creature
videos.overview: A Star Creature appears in the sky, along with a rash of thefts in the stores.

videos.title: The Ghoul, the Bat, and the Ugly
videos.overview: The gang attend the Batty Awards to screen the best horror film of the year. Too bad the Shadow Creature has to shred the film to pieces giving the gang yet another mystery to solve, when all they wanted to do was sit back, relax and munch down on some pop corn.

videos.title: Rocky Mountain Yiiiii!
videos.overview: The ghost of Jeremiah Pratt has frightened skiers and vacationers away from a mountain ski lodge where Scooby and the gang are vacationing.

videos.title: The Sorcerer's a Menace
videos.overview: The gang investigate the disapperance of the Black Pearl of Tonga Lei. The prime suspect is Morgan the Magician's former teacher, the Ghost of the Great Haldayne.

videos.title: Lock the Door, It's a Minotaur
videos.overview: The gang visit the Greek Island of Helos where they run into the terrifying Minotaur, who is half human and half bull. The Minotaur warns them to leave the island, but those meddling kids smell a big steaming pile of bull p* and want to figure out who's really in that Minotaur costume.

videos.title: The Ransom of Scooby Chief
videos.overview: Scooby visits his old neighbourhood where Scrappy hangs out with his old pals, Duke and Annie. As Scrappy reunites with his friends, Scooby and Shaggy are kidnapped and it's up to Scappy and his pals to rescue them.

videos.title: A Close Encounter with a Strange Kind
videos.overview: Scooby, Shaggy and Scrappy are kidnapped by aliens who want to observe earth creatures. The trio's antics, as they try to escape, convince the aliens that earth creatures are not worth studying.

videos.title: A Fit Night Out for Bats
videos.overview: Shaggy, Scooby and Shaggy have a flat tire, they decide to stay in a mansion inhabited by vampires.

videos.title: The Chinese Food Factory
videos.overview: While Shaggy and the dogs are on the job as fortune cookie factory watchmen, they come across a burglar.

videos.title: Scooby's Desert Dilemma
videos.overview: The gang are in Arabia where they meet an evil magician who wants to practice his black magic on the three tourists.

videos.title: The Old Cat and Mouse Game
videos.overview: The gang are visiting the Tibetan Mountains and come across a Cat Man and his gang of evil felines. The Cat Man throws Shaggy, Scooby and Scrappy into the shrinking water fountain reducing them to the size of mice. In their tiny form, the three manage to eventually push the Cat Man into the shrinking water fountain and then escape. Once away from the Cat Man's hideaway the three return to their normal size.

videos.title: Stowaways
videos.overview: Shaggy, Scooby and Scrappy mistake a boat for a floating restaurant. Once abord, they realize their mistake and spend the rest of the cruise avoiding an angry first mate who hates stowaways. To escape this dude, they use a broken lifeboat as a water ski.

videos.title: Mummy's the Word
videos.overview: The trio are in the Sahara Desert where thy run into a Mummy.

videos.title: Hang in There, Scooby
videos.overview: Scooby and the gang go hang gliding, but get caught up in a wind that sends them into trouble.

videos.title: Stuntman Scooby
videos.overview: The gang get mistaken for movie stunt men.

videos.title: Scooby's Three Ding-A-Ling Circus
videos.overview: The three take jobs as circus helpers.

videos.title: Scooby's Fantastic Island
videos.overview: When the gang go fishing, they sail to a deserted island meeting a caveman and other prehistoric creatures.

videos.title: Long John Scrappy
videos.overview: A pirate kidnaps Scrappy, and Scooby and Shaggy try their best to rescue him.

videos.title: Scooby's Bull Fright
videos.overview: Scooby and the gang are bullfighters.

videos.title: Scooby Ghosts West
videos.overview: The gang visits a ghost town, with ghosts to boot.

videos.title: A Bungle in the Jungle
videos.overview: A butterfly hunt turns into a dangerous jungle excursion for Scooby and the gang.

videos.title: Scooby's Fun Zone
videos.overview: Scooby has to compete with a strong man at a carnival thanks to Scrappy.

videos.title: Swamp Witch
videos.overview:
Scooby, Shaggy and Scrappy are a Swamp Witch's dinner guests....and they're the dinner!

One of the few episodes where the Mystery Machine doesn't make an appearance.

videos.title: Sir Scooby and the Black Knight
